title: A second, older EM mouse (V1DD) repeats the 4- to 9-fold EM excess of inhibition between interneurons over slice recordings in mouse V1, so a difference between EM animals does not explain it
abstract: Question: earlier work found that mouse V1 slice recordings (Allen Synaptic Physiology) detect only 14 to 24 percent of the Pvalb->Sst, Sst->Sst, Vip->Pvalb and Vip->Vip connections that MICrONS electron microscopy (EM) shows at matched soma distance. Labels, layers, subpopulations and synapse number did not explain this, and animal differences remained open. Data: a second EM mouse, Allen V1 Deep Dive (V1DD) release 1196 (older, about P163 against about P87), with 450 proofread inhibitory axons, and MICrONS v1507, both with the same target-based m-type labels (PTC, DTC, ITC as Pvalb-, Sst-, Vip-like). Method: ratio R of slice connections to EM-expected connections in 25 um distance bins, joint bootstrap over axons and slices, tests written before any V1DD rate was computed. Results: in V1DD, R was 0.25 (95% CI 0.15-0.38), 0.14 (0.10-0.18), 0.20 (0.08-0.36) and 0.11 (0.06-0.19) for the four pairs; all upper limits are below the pre-set 0.5. MICrONS gave 0.24, 0.18, 0.14 and 0.14. The V1DD/MICrONS ratio of EM rates was 0.94, 1.34, 0.73 and 1.19, and excitatory-to-interneuron controls had R 0.97 to 1.51. Target-normalised double ratios were 0.10 to 0.26 in both mice. Layer strata, distance limits and distance scaling did not change the result. Exploratory: slice rates are a sharper copy of the EM rank order in both mice (rho 0.85 and 0.65, log-log slope 1.9 and 2.0), and fitted per-synapse detection probabilities correlate between mice (rho 0.75). Conclusion: an animal difference does not explain the deficit; anatomical synapses without detectable slice responses, or a pair-specific EM error shared by both pipelines, remain. Limitations: two EM mice from related pipelines, predicted cell types, few Vip-like axons in MICrONS, no proofread-target or axon-extension control in V1DD.

(B) V1DD/MICrONS ratio of EM rates at the slice pair distances; blue band 0.5-2.
